description: Defines the UnixDomainServerSocket class for managing Unix domain socket server operations, including credential handling, accepting connections, and socket binding/listening, with support for abstract namespaces on Linux and Android.

classes.name: UnixDomainServerSocket
classes.description: A server socket class that uses Unix domain sockets as the transport layer, supporting credential retrieval, connection acceptance, and binding/listening functionalities.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: A struct representing the credentials of a peer process connected to the socket, including process ID (on certain platforms), user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: UnixDomainServerSocket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server socket with an authentication callback and namespace usage flag.

methods.name: GetPeerCredentials
methods.description: Static method to retrieve credentials of a peer connected via a socket descriptor.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Sets up the socket to listen on a specified address with a backlog and optional IPv6-only flag.

methods.name: ListenWithAddressAndPort
methods.description: Sets up the socket to listen on a specified address string and port with a backlog.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, returning a StreamSocket.

methods.name: BindAndListen
methods.description: Creates, binds, and listens on a socket at the specified path with a backlog.

methods.name: AcceptSocketDescriptor
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and returns a raw socket descriptor.
